How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Anna University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at Anna University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant post at Anna University is 10-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.E/B.Tech or M.E/M.Tech degree in specific engineering disciplines as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Assistant position announced by Anna University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Anna University located?
faq.answer: Anna University is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600044.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, the application mode specified for this recruitment is strictly via email.
